cards.title: git pull
cards.body: When someone else pushes to GitHub, your copy falls behind. `git pull` downloads their commits and merges them into your branch.

cards.title: Pull before you push
cards.body: If GitHub has work you don't, Git rejects your push until you pull it first.

check.question: Git rejected your push with "fetch first". What do you do?
check.explanation: Pulling brings in the other commits; then your push goes through.

exercise.prompt: A teammate pushed a new commit to GitHub. You are in your copy, `notes`. Pull their work.

checks.label: You have your teammate's `Add a shopping list` commit
